nodes.label: CMA-ES per-mode default rationale
nodes.rationale: static_isotropic (3 params, well-conditioned) defaults CMA-ES off; laminar_flow (7 params) defaults off because the anti-degeneracy controller usually prevents collapse and multistart is primary defence; two_component (heterodyne) defaults on because per-angle contrast/offset multipliers make the landscape genuinely multi-modal so CMA-ES pays for itself.

nodes.label: XLA_FLAGS ordering rationale
nodes.rationale: JAX reads XLA_FLAGS exactly once at backend init, so configure_xla must run before the first import xpcsjax to override package defaults; run as a console script it is purely informational since JAX is already initialised.

nodes.label: Doc-coverage completeness rationale
nodes.rationale: Every xpcsjax submodule must register a py:module target here so internal cross-references resolve; a submodule is omitted only when a dedicated page already uses automodule for it (which registers py:module itself).

nodes.label: Pointwise evaluator not wired rationale
nodes.rationale: HeterodynePointwiseEvaluator matches the meshgrid kernel to ~1 ULP but is deliberately not wired into the production two_component solve: swapping it flips the non-convex trf+soft_l1 solve into a worse basin on degenerate maintainer fixtures (20x-2000x worse chi-squared). Kept as a tested seam for a future more-robust solver.

nodes.label: Heterodyne individual-layout requirement rationale
nodes.rationale: For the heterodyne HeterodynePhysicsAdapter, viz functions require the individual per-angle scaling layout [c_0..c_{n-1}, o_0..o_{n-1}, physical params] because that is the only layout with an explicit per-angle vector to slice; averaged/constant layouts are reconstructed on the fly.

nodes.label: analysis_mode: static deprecation
nodes.rationale: The bare value static was ambiguous between static_isotropic (angle-collapsed) and static_anisotropic (angle-resolved) and silently collapsed downstream, so it is deprecated in favor of exactly four canonical modes; the loader rewrites static to static_anisotropic and warns.

nodes.label: Three distinct version concepts rationale
nodes.rationale: Package version, data-layer provenance version, and config-schema version are intentionally decoupled: the data-layer version tracks the ported upstream xpcs_loader independently, and ConfigManager only warns on a major.minor mismatch against the package version rather than requiring exact sync.

nodes.label: sigma_is_default interpretation caveat
nodes.rationale: When sigma_is_default is True, reduced_chi_squared is on the arbitrary identity-weighting scale and should not be read as an absolute goodness-of-fit; trust the per-parameter uncertainties instead.

nodes.label: angle_filtering rationale
nodes.rationale: angle_filtering keeps only angles where shear modulation is large enough to constrain the four shear parameters; fallback_to_all_angles ensures a fit is still attempted on the full angular range if no target angles match.

nodes.label: WorkflowSelector RuntimeError (obsolete NLSQ API)
nodes.rationale: WorkflowSelector was removed in NLSQ v0.6.0; xpcsjax calls CurveFit directly, so seeing this error means the installed nlsq package predates 0.6.0 and must be upgraded.

nodes.label: Parameter absorption degeneracy
nodes.rationale: If per-angle beta(phi_k) and c_offset(phi_k) are freely optimised, increasing D0 while rescaling beta(phi_k) by exp(q^2 * delta * t_ref) produces identical c2 across all angles, so the physical parameters are not identifiable from per-angle contrasts without a constraint.

nodes.label: Gradient cancellation problem
nodes.rationale: The shear-term gradient w.r.t. gamma_dot_0 is proportional to cos(phi - phi0); summed over angles spanning [0, 2pi) positive and negative contributions cancel, so the optimiser prefers to absorb angle dependence into per-angle scaling rather than driving gamma_dot_0 to its true value, causing gamma_dot_0 to collapse to its lower bound.

nodes.label: Layer 4 strictly-observational rationale
nodes.rationale: The per-iteration callback passed to the NLSQ solver feeds the monitor and always returns None, so monitor-on and monitor-off produce a bit-identical fit trajectory; response_mode configures what get_response() would recommend but no production call site invokes it to change the running solve.

nodes.label: Layer 5 gating to laminar_flow rationale
nodes.rationale: The |cos(phi-phi0)| weighting is derived from the laminar shear gradient d g1/d gamma_dot0 ~ cos(phi-phi0), so it is meaningful only where a shear rate appears in the kernel; static modes have no flow direction, and two_component has a structurally different velocity/flow term, so L5 is gated off for both.

nodes.label: Per-angle scaling degeneracy (2*n_phi free params)
nodes.rationale: The naive choice of 2*N_phi free scaling parameters (beta(phi_k), c_offset(phi_k)) introduces a parameter absorption degeneracy that xpcsjax breaks via the anti-degeneracy controller strategies.

nodes.label: L2 opposite-gating asymmetry rationale
nodes.rationale: The standard joint-fit path gates L2 (hierarchical) on constant/averaged modes (inline two-stage) and no-ops for individual; the STREAMING path gates L2 on individual mode only via HierarchicalOptimizer. This is a real, deliberate asymmetry between the two paths, not a typo.

nodes.label: L5 omission rationale (heterodyne)
nodes.rationale: Heterodyne own velocity/flow term (v0, v_offset, phi0_het) is structurally different from laminar_flow shear rate; the relative weight of the two components already varies informatively with phi, so an additional cos(phi0-phi) weight has no physics motivation. This is a structural decision, not a TODO.

nodes.label: Joint global escape keep-better contract
nodes.rationale: Both joint CMA-ES and joint multistart escapes are accepted only if their data-only SSR beats the plain NLSQ joint fit, and best-effort fall back to the plain joint fit on failure; an escape result is tagged nlsq_diagnostics['global_escape'] and carries NaN covariance since no covariance solve is run on the kept vector.
